_comment: Pterodactyl egg for JMusicBot-ML (multi-language Discord music bot)
name: JMusicBot-ML
author: jmusicbot-ml@example.com
description: Multi-language Discord music bot (based on JMusicBot-JP). Upload JMusicBot-ML.jar with the panel File Manager. Requires Java 25.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo "JMusicBot-ML setup: upload JMusicBot-ML.jar with the panel File Manager."

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: Name of the jar file to run.
